candidate.admitted_scope: Retain canonical bytes from the exact verified parsed config/model as the fixed authority. Keep all four initial live/source canonical comparisons and both full live canonical checks at the original after-load/prepare boundary before borrow. Reject mismatch and poison; never refresh the authority from changed caller state.
order: verified four buffers and source JSON parsing
original ordered short-circuit live/source canonical comparisons for config then model
retain immutable validated source bytes locally; no parsed-object mutable alias
full canonical live config/model at original late boundary; compare to validated source bytes before any cache.use/borrow/query
publish expected bytes only after all checks; unchanged snapshot/owner/key setup and pre-use guard
unchanged every final live config/model canonical and complete snapshot check
candidate.rejection: Any mismatch or failure clears prepared/expected bytes/key/owner/active; no new mutable baseline, silent fallback or retry.
candidate.changed_rejection_semantics: Persistent initialization changes are rejected before borrow instead of potentially being absorbed into the old late baseline for that single borrow; the old next identity lookup may still reject. ABA crossing the late boundary must still reject. No claim to detect a transient restored before every existing discrete boundary.
candidate.byte_rules: Original typed canonical algorithm and complete bytes stay unchanged: bool/int, finite float hex and signed zero, list/tuple, map keys/order, all complete model/support/config fields. Source-file descriptors and S1 snapshot scheme are unchanged.
candidate.policy_binding: Future new method/spec/request/cache-use/receipt/publisher must bind the source-anchor policy; mixed policies reject.

excluded_performance_branch.reason: Blind early-byte retention loses the original late temporal observation. A→B at late capture then B→A before final passes the naive early-A rule but the original guard rejects.
prerequisites: Separately specify and prove a closed immutable caller-ownership envelope covering all callees/watch/observer/aliases, without shifting or hiding work.
Or separately specify an algorithm that performs a complete canonical-equivalent typed content comparison at the same late boundary. This is a new algorithm, not pure byte reuse.
Pass the ABA/unsupported-type/failure and complete source/scientific equivalence matrix before permitting any fewer serializations.

preserved.identity: Original binding, complete request/namespace/process/environment/model/config key and exact direct methods; only append future method/spec/acceptance records.
preserved.integrity: Original create and post-lock source checks; every final live canonical check; 15 live snapshot fingerprints for one cold/six hits; independent publisher rebuild, source checks, scientific bytes/SQL/Decimal/hex and stopped full log manifest.

acceptance.inherited: All applicable C1-S1 70 required cases, V34 direct/log lifecycle, V35 exact-byte/watch/identity/lock regressions. Existing six temporal counterexamples are inventory evidence, not candidate acceptance.
acceptance.gate: No candidate implementation is authorized by this design-only run. Any future implementation uses new files and must first pass concrete mapped tests and commit immutable acceptance before a separately frozen real comparison.

cost_context.interpretation: The admitted safe path still performs six cold canonical calls. The observed late cost is not an achievable saving; no transfer of replay medians into original48 acceleration.
